principle: Published findings are benchmark ground truth. CIP Intelligence results must be compared against them without rewriting or inflating the source claims.

benchmarks.title: Industrial UHT heat-exchanger CIP rationalization
benchmarks.sampling: 20 s during production; 5 s during launch and cleaning
published_findings: Sensor and tracer evidence can determine useful end points for CIP phases in real time.
Wastewater volume could be reduced by about half.
Caustic and acid use could be reduced by up to a few tens of kilograms per cleaning.
Total cleaning duration could be reduced substantially by ending phases when evidence showed the endpoint was reached.
what_cip_intelligence_should_test: reconstruct cleaning phases from timestamped process evidence
identify stable rinse endpoint from conductivity or turbidity behavior
quantify avoidable phase duration and resource use
withhold microbiological-cleanliness claims because process sensors alone do not establish them
benchmarks.validation_state: awaiting raw or reconstructed research fixture

benchmarks.title: Three-stage scraped-surface heat-exchanger CIP optimization
benchmarks.data_status: paper reports design and optimized conditions; raw run table not yet ingested
published_findings: Optimized solution: about 0.85% NaOH, 72.7 C, and 150 RPM scraper speed.
Predicted optimized responses were comparable with mean experimental validation values and were not significantly different (p > 0.05).
what_cip_intelligence_should_test: separate process-condition optimization from microbiological outcome evidence
rank operating-condition combinations using duration and sanitation outcomes
avoid declaring an optimum from process variables when microbial outcome data are absent

benchmarks.title: Pulsed-flow CIP sanitization in dairy piping
benchmarks.data_status: published study available; raw sensor table not located
published_findings: Pulsation variables were significant for cell removal.
Cell removal differed by geometry, with straight cylinders performing better than elbows in the reported experiment.
The study evaluated pulsed flow as a way to improve hygiene while reducing energy use.
what_cip_intelligence_should_test: detect geometry and process context as effect modifiers
compare stationary and pulsed-flow runs without assuming higher flow is always better
keep microbial cell-removal evidence distinct from hydraulic process evidence

benchmarks.title: External membrane-bioreactor process dataset
benchmarks.source: Zenodo external dataset used for importer stress testing
benchmarks.data_status: sample CSV tested in live app
what_cip_intelligence_should_test: recognize generic measurement families without inventing CIP meaning
refuse to create a fake CIP cycle when the file is generic process data
benchmarks.validation_state: ingestion behavior verified; not a dairy-CIP validation benchmark
